profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Hometap
profile.summary:
I'm a software engineer at Hometap working to make homeownership more accessible and less stressful. I lead projects as engineer champion, coordinate large technical discussions, and apply AI-assisted development from debugging to design to delivery.

I graduated from Northeastern University with a BS in Computer Science, a concentration in Human-Centered Computing, and a minor in Spanish. I’m passionate about interdisciplinary learning and enjoy exploring other branches of engineering, especially aerospace. During my time at Northeastern, I was an active member of AerospaceNU, the university’s aerospace club, where I deepened my interest in the field and collaborated on hands-on engineering projects.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: I'm currently a Software Engineer II at Hometap. I help create solutions that support our mission of making homeownership more accessible and less stressful.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer Co-op
positions.description: I worked as a Full Stack Engineer Co-op at Hometap, working on both the frontend and backend services. I developed and implemented solutions in React, Javascript, and Python related to website and database management.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Django · JavaScript · HTML · Databases · Web Technologies · Full-Stack Development · React.js

positions.title: Software Engineer Co-Op
positions.locationName: Syracuse, New York, United States · On-site
positions.description: I worked as a software engineer co-op at SRC Inc. for my first co-op. I learned of my love for fast-paced development and innovation through this experience. In this role, I designed and executed code for both Android and Python.
positions.insights: Skills: Android Development · Problem Solving · Java · Presentations · Teamwork

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: I was a teaching assistant for Fundamentals of Computer Science, where I teach the fundamentals of coding through Racket and Java. I was the lead TA for two of the computer science labs.

positions.title: Student Success Guide
positions.description: I was a student success guide for Northeastern University. I provided resources and referrals for first-year Northeastern students.

positions.title: Food Counter Clerk
positions.description: I was responsible for the food stand, including taking orders, managing produce, and running the cash register.

positions.title: Food Counter Clerk
positions.description: I ran the Reeves Farms Stand, including managing the cash register, stocking produce, and taking orders.

volunteerExperiences.description:
Link to website about the project: https://pages.github.ccs.neu.edu/katsu1682/katsu1682.github.io/index.html
I worked with two other students to create interactive data visualizations for Apprentice Learning using survey data from students and program heads. These visualizations were for their website, grant applications, and social media. The visualizations were written in HTML, CSS, and Javascript.
